# Triple1s Real Estate Solutions (Triple1s Global, LLC)

> Direct, as-is cash home buyer, statewide Florida vacant land buyer, and South Florida foreclosure/tax-deed surplus recovery specialist. Bilingual English & Español.

- Legal Entity: Triple1s Global, LLC (dba Triple1s Real Estate Solutions) — acting strictly as a principal buyer, not a licensed Florida real estate broker or law firm.

## Core Services
- **As-Is Cash Home Buying (Miami-Dade & Broward Counties, FL):** Direct cash offers within 24 hours, 0% realtor commissions, 14–21 day closings through licensed Florida title companies, remote/mobile notary options, and post-closing occupancy flexibility ("Let's Make a Deal Work for You").
- **Complex Property Solutions:** Inherited & probate homes, code violations, open/expired permits, delinquent property taxes, pre-foreclosure relief, tired landlords/tenant-occupied homes, and roof/storm damage.
- **Vacant Land & Empty Lots (Statewide Florida):** Cash purchases of unused residential, infill, and acreage lots across all 67 Florida counties (Miami-Dade, Broward, Port St. Lucie, Cape Coral, Lehigh Acres, Palm Bay, Ocala, etc.).
- **Surplus Funds Recovery (Miami-Dade & Broward, FL):** Public-record audit and recovery assistance for post-auction mortgage foreclosure surplus (Fla. Stat. § 45.033 — 12% statutory fee cap, 60-day assignment window) and tax deed surplus (Fla. Stat. § 197.582 — 120-day lienholder window), $0 upfront cost.

## Service Areas
- **Miami-Dade County:** Miami, Coral Gables, Hialeah, Homestead, Kendall, North Miami, Miami Gardens, Doral, Opa-locka.
- **Broward County:** Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Pembroke Pines, Miramar, Pompano Beach, Coral Springs, Plantation, Lauderhill.
- **Vacant Land:** Statewide across all 67 counties in Florida.
